subject: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-25T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners

Hi all,

Quick note to align on acceptance criteria for the Promptset A/B plan and who owns each gating check before we schedule the canary. Attached is a draft playbook (eval_playbook_v2.pdf) — please scan the acceptance section and call out any missing checks.

Proposed acceptance (high level):
- Quality: reduction in factual-error rate on the critical-entities subset by >= 30%.
- Safety: no increase in high-severity safety flags (<= baseline).
- Cost: token cost delta <= +10%.
- Latency: p95 increase <= 5%.
- Business guardrail: user-task completion proxy uplift >= +2% (if measurable within canary window).

Owners I propose:
- Marissa: evaluation metrics + sampling plan
- Karthik: gating infra and canary sizing/rollout policy
- Grace: QA sample failures and escalation
- Ben: product sign-off on business guardrails
- Jonas: observability/tracing + instrumentation tags

Ask: can we lock thresholds and owners by EOD Friday (2028-07-28)? If you have suggested numbers (sample sizes, windows) drop them inline.

Thanks,

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: eval_playbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-25T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners

Kim — thanks. Quick reactions:
- Agree with the buckets. I want to tighten the factual-error reduction to >=25% on the 'adversarial-critical' split (we saw higher variance there) and require per-category pass rates (no category drops >5%).
- Sample size: target 10k unique prompts per arm over a 72-hour window for initial canary; if traffic is low, synthetic augmentation allowed but flagged.
- Metrics backstop: if we see a regression in any of the top-5 customer-facing intents, we auto-hold rollout.

I've attached a quick sample list for the promptset (promptset_ab_samples.csv). I'll add an evaluation dashboard link once I finish the metric SQLs.

—Marissa

Attachment: promptset_ab_samples.csv (text/csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-26T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners

Heads-up on infra constraints:
- Canary minimum: 5k requests per arm to get stable p95 latency and cost numbers; 10k preferred for quality metrics.
- We'll run the canary on a single Dedicated pool with KV cache disabled for parity with baseline. If cache changes, we must tag and rebaseline.
- Rollout policy: canary -> 10% for 24 hours -> 50% for 12 hours -> full, with automatic rollback on any threshold breach.

I'll prepare a gating checklist (health, error rates, latency, token cost, QA flags) and share it before EOD Thu (2028-07-27).

-Karthik
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-26T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners

Adding QA concerns:
- We need an adversarial subset (explicitly call out hallucination-prone templates). Marissa's suggested 'adversarial-critical' is right.
- Require snapshot logs for any failures and a quick triage guide (who triages first: Grace -> Marissa -> Ben).
- If more than 2% of sampled responses are 'unclassifiable' by our rubric, we fail the canary.

I'll draft the triage playbook and link it to the gating checklist.

-Grace
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-27T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners

Observability notes:
- Please add a tracing tag: eval_rollout=promptset_v2_ab so we can filter traces.
- I'll add dashboards for the per-intent regression checks and a synthetic-run job to run the adversarial subset every 6 hours during canary.
- Fallback policy: on rollback, route 100% traffic to baseline pool and mark the rollout as 'paused' in the console; also create a lightweight incident doc.

I'll push the dashboard links to the drive folder (same as Kimberly's link).

-Jonas
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-28T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval alignment: acceptance metrics & A/B owners

Thanks everyone — consolidating decisions:
- Acceptance: factual-error reduction >=25% on adversarial-critical; no category drops >5%; safety flags <= baseline; cost <= +10%; latency p95 <= +5%; business uplift goal +2% proxy.
- Sample/window: 10k per arm over 72 hours (Marissa).
- Infra gating: 5k min, prefer 10k; KV cache disabled (Karthik).
- QA triage: Grace owns the triage playbook; failure definition: >2% unclassifiable.
- Observability & rollback policy: Jonas.

Owners updated in playbook. I'll push the updated playbook + gating checklist + dashboard links to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EvalPlaybook_shared

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize SQLs and dashboards (due 2028-07-29)
- Karthik: gating checklist + canary policy in infra repo (due 2028-07-29)
- Grace: triage playbook draft (due 2028-07-29)
- Jonas: dashboard + tracing tags (due 2028-07-29)
- Ben: confirm business guardrail measurement (due 2028-07-29)

If no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll schedule canary for week of 2028-07-31.

Best,
Kimberly
